apparatus.crit: ekaṃ tv icchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate
tato hate mahāvīrye vr̥tre devabhayaṃkare anr̥tenābhibhūto
jaladān āhur vidyutaś ca tvam eva hi dahanti
droṇād arjunād vāsudevāt; kr̥pād bhīṣmād yena
kaccin na pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta; te pāṇḍavānāṃ
etāni sarvāṇy upasevamāno; devarājyaṃ maghavān prāpa mukhyam
yo ’yaṃ lobhān manyate dharmam etaṃ; yam icchate manyuvaśānugāmī

apparatus.vulgate: hantuṃ ca yo necchati pāpakaṃ vai

apparatus.crit: bhavaty atibale hy etaj jñānam apy upaghātakam
sarve samadhirūḍhāḥ sma saṃgrāmān naḥ samuddhara

apparatus.vulgate: gatasādhvasam sarvān janapadān sūta yodhā duryodhanasya ye

apparatus.crit: arjunas tan mahad vākyam abravīl lomaharṣaṇam
r̥te ca dhanam aśvānāṃ nāvāptir vidyate tava arthaṃ
devair manuṣyair gandharvair asurair uragaiś ca
nirvādair nirvaded enam antatas tad bhaviṣyati
api te pūjitāḥ pūrvam api te suhr̥do matāḥ
saṃgrāmaṃ yojayet tatra tāṃ hy āhuḥ
arjunena samaṃ yuddhaṃ mama yaudhiṣṭhire bale
ācāryo vā mahābāho bhāradvājaḥ kim abravīt

apparatus.vulgate: yaḥ saheta raṇe bhīṣmaṃ śarārciḥ pāvakopamam taṃ

apparatus.crit: mayāpi hi mahābāho tvatpriyārtham ariṃdama kr̥to
gaṇas tv āsīd gaṇās tv ayutaśo
uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sāntvapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ
pārthivam śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca pāñcālyaṃ sahadevaṃ ca māgadham
ko nu bhīṣmaṃ yudhā jetum utsaheta mahīpatiḥ
kasmād dhi tan mr̥ṣā kartum arhati
bhāryā coḍhā tvayā rājan daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā
bhavitavyaṃ tathā tad dhi mama duḥkhāya kaurava
